<blog>

# Webradio: Complete IoT Internet Radio System

## Project Overview

Webradio is a comprehensive DIY IoT Internet Radio system that combines hardware and software components to create a fully functional radio player with multiple control interfaces. The project consists of four interconnected components communicating over a local MQTT network.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **Multi-platform Control**: Provide remote control capabilities through Android app, web interface, and physical hardware buttons
- **Real-time Communication**: Enable instant status updates and command execution across all interfaces
- **Hardware Integration**: Seamlessly integrate ESP32 microcontroller with audio processing, display, and control systems
- **Extensible Architecture**: Support multiple radio devices and customizable station lists

## Technical Architecture

The system follows a distributed architecture with clear separation of concerns:

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph "User Interfaces"
        A[Android App]
        B[Web Browser]
        C[Physical Buttons]
    end

    subgraph "Control Layer"
        D[MQTT Broker]
        E[Web Server]
    end

    subgraph "Hardware Layer"
        F[ESP32 Radio]
        G[Audio Processing]
        H[Display System]
    end

    A <---> D
    B <---> E
    C --> F
    D <---> F
    E <---> D
    F --> G
    F --> H
```

### System Relationships

The architecture employs a publish-subscribe pattern where:
- **User Interfaces** publish commands to MQTT topics
- **ESP32 Hardware** subscribes to control topics and executes actions
- **Status Updates** flow bidirectionally for real-time synchronization
- **Web Server** bridges HTTP requests to MQTT protocol

## Key Implementation Components

### ESP32 Firmware (`WebRadio_ESP32_S3`)

The core microcontroller implementation provides:

#### Hardware Integration
- **Audio Processing**: ESP32-audioI2S library for high-quality audio streaming
- **Display System**: U8g2 library for OLED SSD1306 display management
- **Physical Controls**: EncButton library for button handling and debouncing
- **Network Connectivity**: WiFi and MQTT client integration

#### Audio Management
- **Stream Handling**: Dynamic station switching with automatic reconnect logic
- **Volume Control**: Smooth volume ramp-up during power-on sequences
- **Metadata Parsing**: Real-time extraction of station titles and audio properties
- **Error Handling**: Robust recovery mechanisms for network failures

#### Control Logic
- **MQTT Communication**: Bidirectional message processing for commands and status
- **Alarm System**: TimeAlarms integration for scheduled power operations
- **Telegram Integration**: FastBot library for remote administration
- **EEPROM Storage**: Persistent alarm configuration and state management

### Android Application (`WebRadio_android`)

A modern Kotlin-based Android application featuring:

#### UI/UX Design
- **Jetpack Compose**: Modern declarative UI framework
- **Responsive Layouts**: Adaptive grid system for different screen sizes
- **Real-time Updates**: Live status monitoring with automatic refresh
- **Custom Theming**: Configurable color schemes and visual feedback

#### Communication Layer
- **MQTT Integration**: Paho MQTT client for reliable message transport
- **Data Persistence**: DataStore for settings and preferences
- **Background Services**: Efficient resource management and lifecycle handling
- **Error Handling**: Graceful degradation and user feedback mechanisms

#### User Features
- **Station Management**: Preset station selection with genre categorization
- **Alarm Control**: Configurable wake-up schedules with time-based validation
- **Device Switching**: Multi-device support with seamless transitions
- **Volume Control**: Incremental adjustment with visual indicators

### Web Interface (`WebRadio_web`)

A Node.js-based web application providing:

#### Backend Architecture
- **Express Server**: RESTful API endpoints with comprehensive validation
- **WebSocket Integration**: Real-time bidirectional communication
- **Security Measures**: Helmet protection, rate limiting, and token authentication
- **MQTT Bridge**: Seamless translation between HTTP and MQTT protocols

#### Frontend Features
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with adaptive layouts
- **Live Updates**: WebSocket-powered real-time status synchronization
- **Command Validation**: Server-side request validation and sanitization
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error reporting and user notifications

#### API Endpoints
- **Status Monitoring**: Real-time radio state and metadata retrieval
- **Command Execution**: Safe command publishing with validation
- **Authentication**: Token-based access control for secure operations
- **WebSocket Access**: Direct command submission through WebSocket connections

### Python Utilities (`WebRadio_python_utils`)

Supporting tools for station management:

#### Command-line Player
- **VLC Integration**: Native audio playback with extensive codec support
- **Playlist Management**: Dynamic station switching and playlist manipulation
- **Interactive Control**: Console-based station selection and playback control
- **Thread Management**: Concurrent operation for continuous playback

#### Data Processing Tools
- **JSON Conversion**: Automated station list transformation
- **Sorting Algorithms**: Duplicate removal and list optimization
- **Quality Assessment**: Stream quality evaluation and filtering

## Key Features

### Multi-Interface Control
- **Real-time Synchronization**: All interfaces share identical state information
- **Command Broadcasting**: Single command execution affects all connected clients
- **Conflict Resolution**: Intelligent handling of simultaneous user interactions
- **Fallback Mechanisms**: Graceful degradation when individual components fail

### Hardware Integration
- **Audio Quality**: High-fidelity streaming with configurable bitrate support
- **Display Information**: Comprehensive station metadata and audio property display
- **Physical Feedback**: LED indicators and tactile button responses
- **Power Management**: Efficient power cycling and sleep mode implementation

### Network Architecture
- **MQTT Protocol**: Lightweight, reliable message delivery
- **Local Network Focus**: Designed for LAN-only operation
- **Security Considerations**: Authentication and authorization mechanisms
- **Scalability**: Support for multiple radio devices on same network

### Development Architecture
- **Modular Design**: Clear separation of concerns across components
- **Configuration Management**: Environment-specific settings and credentials
- **Testing Strategy**: Comprehensive testing across all layers
- **Documentation**: Extensive inline documentation and usage guides

## Component Relationship Diagrams

### Data Flow Architecture
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User Interface
    participant Broker as MQTT Broker
    participant ESP32 as ESP32 Radio
    participant Display as OLED Display
    
    User->>+Broker: Control Command
    Broker->>+ESP32: Forward Command
    ESP32->>+Display: Update Status
    ESP32-->>-Broker: Status Update
    Broker-->>-User: Real-time Feedback
    Display-->>-User: Visual Indicators
```

### Hardware Component Integration
```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph "Audio System"
        A[ESP32-audioI2S]
        B[I2S DAC]
        C[Amplifier]
        D[Speakers]
    end
    
    subgraph "Display System"
        E[U8g2 Library]
        F[SSD1306 OLED]
    end
    
    subgraph "Control System"
        G[EncButton Library]
        H[Physical Buttons]
        I[Relay Control]
    end
    
    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    
    E --> F
    
    G --> H
    G --> I
    I --> A
```

## Conclusion and Recommendations

### Architectural Strengths

1. **Robust Communication**: MQTT-based architecture ensures reliable, real-time communication
2. **Hardware Integration**: Comprehensive hardware abstraction with proper error handling
